title: Solomon's Temple
description: Solomon builds the magnificent temple in Jerusalem. At the dedication, God's glory fills the house.

versions.reason: [major] references: The proposal overlaps significantly with the existing 'solomons-dedication-of-the-temple' (1 Kings 8). However, the proposal also covers chapters 6–7 (the actual construction), so it should be merged into one broader story about Solomon's Temple.
